outcome: Diagnosis of the cause of postpartum hemorrhage (PPH)
Deep tearing extending to the lower uterine segment and uterine artery
cohort: The study included 15 patients with postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) who were transferred from local clinics between January 2010 and December 2011.
finding: CT imaging effectively revealed diverse underlying causes of PPH in the majority of cases, identifying specific pathologies such as deep tearing, arteriovenous malformations, and uterine pseudoaneurysms.
